_ordering_rationale: Ordre par PV decroissante. NII = moteur revenu, NIM = spread profitability, Domestic Card NCO = signal credit risk consumer, Purchase volume = engagement card holder, total revenue = scale.

kpis.signal: Croissance soutenue portee par expansion portefeuille cartes credit, ~80% du revenu
kpis.description_fr: Difference entre interets recus (prets, titres) et interets payes (depots, dettes). Coeur du business model Capital One, banque dominee par cartes credit.
kpis.description_en: Difference between interest earned (loans, securities) and interest paid (deposits, debt). Core Capital One revenue driver, credit-card-dominated bank.

kpis.signal: NIM tres eleve vs banques traditionnelles (~3%), reflet mix cartes credit subprime/near-prime
kpis.description_fr: NII / actifs productifs moyens. NIM Capital One structurellement haut (mix cartes credit), expansion 2024 sur hausse yields actifs + portefeuille cartes.
kpis.description_en: NII / average interest-earning assets. Capital One structurally high NIM (credit card mix), 2024 expansion on higher asset yields + card portfolio growth.

kpis.signal: Normalisation post-COVID + stress consommateur, signal credit risk critique pour Capital One
kpis.description_fr: Taux annuel pertes nettes (charge-offs - recoveries) / encours moyen cartes credit Domestic Card. KPI risque credit le plus suivi par investisseurs COF.
kpis.description_en: Annualized net charge-offs (charge-offs - recoveries) / average Domestic Card loans. Most-watched COF credit risk KPI.
kpis._specific_to: Capital One Domestic Card credit risk

kpis.signal: Decelaration 2024 sur prudence consommateur, mais base instal cartes croissante
kpis.description_fr: Total transactions d'achat sur cartes credit Domestic Card, hors avance especes et transferts solde. Mesure engagement card holders + revenus interchange.
kpis.description_en: Domestic Card purchase transactions, ex cash advance and balance transfers. Measures card-holder engagement + interchange revenue base.

kpis.signal: Top line consolidee NII + Non-interest, croissance soutenue malgre cycle credit difficile
kpis.description_fr: NII + revenus non-interets (interchange, frais, services). Top line consolidee Capital One avant provisions.
kpis.description_en: NII + non-interest income (interchange, fees, services). Capital One consolidated pre-provision top line.
